    COMMISSION IMPLEMENTING DECISION (EU) 2026/2215

    of 28 September 2026

    amending Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 concerning certain emergency measures relating to infection with lumpy skin disease virus in France

    (notified under document C(2026) 6963)

    (Only the French text is authentic)

    (Text with EEA relevance)

    THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION,

    Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union,

    Having regard to Regulation (EU) 2016/429 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 March 2016 on transmissible animal diseases and amending and repealing certain acts in the area of animal health (‘Animal Health Law’) (1), and in particular Article 259(1) thereof,

    Whereas:

    (1)

    Infection with lumpy skin disease virus is an infectious, vector-borne disease affecting bovine animals. Its occurrence can have a severe impact on the concerned animal population and on the profitability of farming, causing disturbance to movements of those animals and products thereof within the Union and exports to third countries. In the event of an outbreak of infection with lumpy skin disease virus in bovine animals, there is a serious risk of the spread of that disease to other establishments of bovine animals particularly due its main mode of transmission through vectors.

    (2)

    Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/687 (2) supplements the rules for the control of the listed diseases referred to in Article 9(1), points (a), (b) and (c), of Regulation (EU) 2016/429, and defined as category A, B and C diseases in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/1882 (3). In particular, Articles 21 and 22 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/687 provide for the establishment of a restricted zone in the event of an outbreak of a category A disease, including infection with lumpy skin disease virus, and for certain measures to be applied therein. In addition, Article 21(1) of that Delegated Regulation provides that the restricted zone is to comprise at least a protection zone, a surveillance zone, and, if necessary, further restricted zones around or adjacent to the protection and surveillance zones.

    (3)

    Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 (4) lays down certain emergency measures related to outbreaks of infection with lumpy skin disease virus in France. More particularly, Article 1 of Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 provides for the establishment in France of a restricted zone, comprising protection and surveillance zones, in accordance with Article 21 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/687, as well as a vaccination zone in accordance with Part 1 of Annex IX to Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/361 (5). In addition, Article 1 of Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 provides that those protection and surveillance zones, as well as the vaccination zone, are to comprise at least the areas listed in the Annexes thereto, and the measures required to be applied in those zones are to be applied at least until the dates set out in those Annexes.

    (4)

    Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/361 lays down specific rules for the use of emergency protective vaccination in bovine animals for the prevention and control of infection with lumpy skin disease virus. In particular, point 1 of Part 1 of Annex IX to that Delegated Regulation distinguishes between vaccination zone I, where there are no restrictions linked to outbreaks of lumpy skin disease, and vaccination zone II, where restrictions apply in response to outbreaks of that disease.

    (5)

    The vaccination zones established in Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 remain necessary, and vaccination should continue in accordance with France’s official vaccination plan, which was submitted pursuant to Article 6(4), points (a) and (b), of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/361.

    (6)

    Since the last amendment of Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 by Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/662 (6), France has informed the Commission of an update concerning the vaccination zones established in the Regions of Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes and Bourgogne-Franche-Comté and currently listed as vaccination zone II in Part A of Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708. According to the information provided by France, restrictions linked to outbreaks of infection with lumpy skin disease virus no longer apply in those areas, while vaccination is to continue in accordance with France’s official vaccination plan.

    (7)

    In view of that information, and in accordance with point 1.1 of Part 1 of Annex IX to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/361, the areas concerned in the Regions of Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes and Bourgogne-Franche-Comté should therefore no longer be listed as vaccination zone II and should instead be listed as vaccination zone I in Part B of Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708.

    (8)

    The type, size and duration of vaccination zones I and II set out in Parts B and A of Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 are based on the epidemiological situation as regards infection with lumpy skin disease virus and the progress of the vaccination campaigns in France, particularly taking into account, the Member State’s official vaccination plan, and the progress reports submitted in accordance with Article 11 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/361, as well as on the requirements laid down in Annex IX to that Delegated Regulation.

    (9)

    Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 should, therefore, be amended accordingly.

    (10)

    In light of the current epidemiological situation in France as regards infection with lumpy skin disease virus, the amendments to be made to Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 by this Decision should apply as soon as possible in order to ensure that the vaccination zones laid down at Union level reflect the current situation and to avoid any unnecessary disturbance to trade within the Union or any unjustified barriers to trade with third countries.

    (11)

    The measures provided for in this Decision are in accordance with the opinion of the Standing Committee on Plants, Animals, Food and Feed,

    HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:

    Article 1

    The Annex II to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 is replaced by the text set out in the Annex to this Decision.

    Article 2

    This Decision is addressed to the French Republic.

    Done at Brussels, 28 September 2026.

    For the Commission

    Olivér VÁRHELYI

    Member of the Commission

    (1)   OJ L 84, 31.3.2016, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/429/oj.

    (2)  Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/687 of 17 December 2019 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/429 of the European Parliament and the Council, as regards rules for the prevention and control of certain listed diseases (OJ L 174, 3.6.2020, p. 64, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2020/687/oj).

    (3)  Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/1882 of 3 December 2018 on the application of certain disease prevention and control rules to categories of listed diseases and establishing a list of species and groups of species posing a considerable risk for the spread of those listed diseases (OJ L 308, 4.12.2018, p. 21, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2018/1882/oj).

    (4)  Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 of 29 July 2025 concerning certain emergency measures relating to infection with lumpy skin disease virus in France and repealing Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1336 (OJ L, 2025/1708, 5.8.2025, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec_impl/2025/1708/oj).

    (5)  Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/361 of 28 November 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/429 of the European Parliament and the Council as regards rules for the use of certain veterinary medicinal products for the purpose of prevention and control of certain listed diseases (OJ L 52, 20.2.2023, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2023/361/oj).

    (6)  Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/662 of 13 March 2026 amending the Annexes to Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1708 concerning certain emergency measures relating to infection with lumpy skin disease virus in France (OJ L, 2026/662, 20.3.2026, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec_impl/2026/662/oj).
